name: opcli
description: Agent-first, human-second library for building CLIs

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/smoke-node.ts --rewrite-dts
scripts.prepack: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/smoke-node.ts --rewrite-dts
scripts.prepublishOnly: node --test test/*.test.ts && tsc --noEmit && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/smoke-node.ts --rewrite-dts && node scripts/smoke-node.ts
